# Cult UI

> Open-source Shadcn UI components, animated blocks, and full templates you can copy-paste into any TypeScript/Next.js project. Every component is a shadcn/ui registry item: install it with the shadcn CLI and the source is copied into your project.

- Docs: https://www.cult-ui.com/docs
- Source: https://github.com/nolly-studio/cult-ui
- Every docs page is available as markdown by appending `.md` to its URL.
- Full docs in one file: https://www.cult-ui.com/llms-full.txt

## Install

- Add a component: `npx shadcn@latest add @cult-ui/{name}`. The `@cult-ui` namespace is built into the shadcn CLI, so no config is needed.
- Requires a project set up with `npx shadcn@latest init` (components.json, the `cn` helper, and theme tokens).
- For the shadcn MCP server or older CLIs, list the registry in `components.json`: `"registries": { "@cult-ui": "https://www.cult-ui.com/r/{name}.json" }`
- Without the namespace: `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.cult-ui.com/r/{name}.json`
- Registry index: https://www.cult-ui.com/r/registry.json
- Components use Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn theme tokens, and usually `motion` for animation. Peer dependencies are listed on each component page.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs.md): Motion-rich, niche components for shadcn/ui projects. Accessible, customizable, and open source.
- [Changelog](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/changelog.md): Release notes for Cult UI, covering new shadcn/ui components, API changes, fixes, and registry updates, newest first.
- [Installation](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/installation.md): Install Cult UI components with the shadcn CLI in Next.js, Vite, or any React project using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
- [Manual Installation](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/installation/manual.md): Set up Cult UI without the shadcn CLI by installing the dependencies, cn utility, and Tailwind CSS config yourself.
- [Next.js](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/installation/next.md): Set up a Next.js App Router project with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, then add Cult UI components with the shadcn CLI.
- [Vite](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/installation/vite.md): Set up a Vite React project with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and path aliases, then add Cult UI components with the shadcn CLI.
- [LLMs & Agents](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/llms.md): Give AI coding agents up-to-date Cult UI docs with llms.txt, markdown pages, the shadcn MCP server, and copy-paste agent rules.
- [MCP Server](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/mcp-server.md): Connect the shadcn MCP server to Cursor, Claude Code, or VS Code so AI agents can search and install Cult UI components.
- [Theming](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/theming.md): Theme Cult UI components with shadcn/ui CSS variables and Tailwind CSS v4 tokens, including dark mode and custom brand colors.

## Components

- [Agent Suggest Card Stack](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/agent-suggest-card-stack.md): Stacked AI agent suggestion cards for React and shadcn/ui, with progress bars, success and error states, and a commit button.
- [AI Blob Warp](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/ai-blob-warp.md): Animated AI assistant avatar for React and shadcn/ui, a circle filled with a Paper Design Warp shader that pauses for reduced motion.
- [AI Instructions](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/ai-instructions.md): Composable React components for shadcn/ui to search, toggle, and create custom AI instructions from a popover command list.
- [Analytics Chart](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/analytics-chart.md): Vercel-style SVG line chart for React and shadcn/ui with a gradient stroke and floating tooltip cards for analytics dashboards.
- [Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/apple-iphone-17-pro.md): iPhone 17 Pro device mockup for React and shadcn/ui with Dynamic Island, status bar, and four frame colors for app screenshots.
- [Apple Keyboard](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/apple-keyboard.md): Apple Magic Keyboard illustration for React and shadcn/ui with labeled, pressable keys and a media row for shortcut guides.
- [Apple Pro Display XDR](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/apple-pro-display-xdr.md): Apple Pro Display XDR mockup for React and shadcn/ui with an aluminum frame, screen modes, and an animated macOS dock.
- [Apple Watch Ultra](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/apple-watch-ultra.md): Apple Watch Ultra mockup for React and shadcn/ui with tappable complications, a rotating crown compass, and Motion animation.
- [Background Animate Button](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/bg-animate-button.md): Animated gradient button for React and shadcn/ui with a rotating conic background, preset gradients, CVA variants, and asChild.
- [Fractal Dot Grid](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/bg-animated-fractal-grid.md): Interactive canvas dot grid background for React and shadcn/ui with a hover wave, optional noise, and a mouse-following glow.
- [Background Image Texture](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/bg-image-texture.md): Texture background wrapper for React and shadcn/ui that layers fabric, grid-noise, or paper textures behind content at any opacity.
- [Background Media](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/bg-media.md): Full screen image or video background for React and shadcn/ui with a light or dark overlay and a play and pause control.
- [Border Beam Button](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/border-beam-button.md): shadcn/ui Button with an animated border beam, in text and icon variants, for primary calls to action in React apps.
- [Border Beam Card](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/border-beam-card.md): React card for shadcn/ui with an animated border-beam glow on the compound Card API, for featured plans and active AI tasks.
- [Border Beam Input](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/border-beam-input.md): React input for shadcn/ui built on Base UI with an animated border-beam glow along the bottom edge or the full border.
- [Canvas Fractal Grid](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/canvas-fractal-grid.md): Interactive canvas dot grid hero background for React and shadcn/ui with animated gradients, noise, glow, and performance presets.
- [Choice Poll](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/choice-poll.md): Composable React poll for shadcn/ui with single or multiple choice, result bars with percentages, and keyboard navigation.
- [Circuit Board](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/circuit-board.md): Animated SVG circuit board illustration for React and shadcn/ui with glowing traces around a central chip, for AI and dev tools.
- [Code Block](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/code-block.md): Code block for React and shadcn/ui with tabs for npm, pnpm, and yarn snippets, a copy button, and animated tab switching.
- [Collab Avatar](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/collab-avatar.md): Presence avatar for React and shadcn/ui showing initials on a color-tinted gradient, for collaborative editors and whiteboards.
- [Collab Toolbar](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/collab-toolbar.md): Collaborative editor toolbar for React and shadcn/ui that groups icon buttons and collaborator avatars into divided sections.
- [Color Picker](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/color-picker.md): Color picker for React and shadcn/ui with hue, saturation, and lightness sliders, hex or HSL input, and preset swatches.
- [Copy Button](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/copy-button.md): Copy to clipboard button for React and shadcn/ui with a legacy fallback and an animated check icon, for code and API keys.
- [Cosmic Button](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/cosmic-button.md): Animated link or button for React and shadcn/ui with a glowing cosmic gradient border that grows on hover, for landing page CTAs.
- [Cutout Card](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/cutout-card.md): Composable image card for React and shadcn/ui with cutout corner accents, inset labels, pins, and actions revealed on hover.
- [Direction Aware Tabs](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/direction-aware-tabs.md): Animated tabs for React and shadcn/ui that slide content left or right based on direction and smoothly resize to fit.

- [Dither Image](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/dither-image.md): next/image wrapper for React and shadcn/ui that applies a CSS-only Bayer dither effect, with full-frame and partial masked reveals.

- [Terminal Animation](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/terminal-animation.md): Composable animated terminal for React and shadcn/ui that plays typed commands and output, with tabbed scenarios for CLI docs.
- [Text Animate](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/text-animate.md): Text animation for React and shadcn/ui built with Motion, with presets like fadeIn, rollIn, and whipInUp for headlines.
- [Text GIF](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/text-gif.md): Display text for React and shadcn/ui clipped to an animated GIF background, with size, weight, and font variants.
- [Texture Button](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/texture-button.md): Tactile neumorphic button for React and shadcn/ui with layered borders and gradients, multiple variants and sizes, and asChild.
- [Texture Card](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/texture-card.md): Composable neumorphic card for React and shadcn/ui with layered borders and header, content, footer, and separator parts.
- [Texture Overlay](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/texture-overlay.md): CSS texture overlay for React and shadcn/ui with dots, grid, crosshatch, halftone, and paper grain patterns at any opacity.
- [3D Carousel](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/three-d-carousel.md): 3D image carousel for React and shadcn/ui that rotates cards around a cylinder with drag momentum and click to expand.
- [Timer](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/timer.md): Compound timer for React and shadcn/ui with variants, sizes, and time formats, plus a useTimer hook for elapsed time.
- [Toolbar Expandable](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/toolbar-expandable.md): Expandable toolbar for React and shadcn/ui that opens into a scrollable step-by-step panel, for onboarding and feature tours.
- [Tweet Grid](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/tweet-grid.md): Masonry grid of embedded tweets for React and shadcn/ui from a list of tweet IDs, for testimonial walls and social proof.
- [Typewriter](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/typewriter.md): Typewriter text effect for React and shadcn/ui that types a phrase, then loops rotating words with a blinking cursor.
- [Vote Tally](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/vote-tally.md): Composable upvote list for React and shadcn/ui with accessible vote buttons, sorting by count, and controlled or uncontrolled state.
- [Wizard Expandable](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/wizard-expandable.md): Expandable multi-step wizard for React and shadcn/ui with Motion transitions, keyboard navigation, and step validation.
- [YouTube Video Player](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/youtube-video-player.md): YouTube video player for React and shadcn/ui with a custom thumbnail and play button that expands into an animated modal.
